a.lede: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.
a.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you

b.lede: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plugins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.
b.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plugins with app-like interfaces and automations
